items.title: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq Pops As Fed Rate-Hike Odds Fall; Sezzle Loses Its Sizzle (Live Coverage)
items.summary: The Nasdaq composite was a standout among major indexes Friday, with technology stocks climbing after U.S. job losses cut the odds of the Federal Reserve raising interest rates.  On the stock market today, financial name Sezzle plummeted while a medical tests maker popped following earnings reports.  The Nasdaq composite forged ahead 1.1%.

items.title: SpaceX, Doximity, Trade Desk, Rigetti, Coherent, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  Stocks rose Friday with tech names picking up steam after the U.S. jobs report for July was softer than expected, resulting in Wall Street rethinking whether the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates any time soon.

items.title: S&P 500, Dow Head for Best Weekly Performance Since April
items.summary: U.S. stocks haven't had a week this strong for months.  The S&P 500 and Dow are up 2.9% and 2.7%, respectively, through Thursday—putting both on track for their largest weekly gains since the week ending April 17.
